summary: Hims & Hers Health, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of EUC Management Pty Ltd (d/b/a Eucalyptus). The filing amends the company's credit agreement to facilitate the closing, including a grace period for covenant compliance. No price, premium, or ex-financial terms are disclosed. The acquisition had been previously announced. The board authorized the amendment. The deal closed May 29, 2026, with a press release issued June 2. Watch for integration updates and potential accretion/dilution disclosure in subsequent filings.
